steps.raw_text:
I can see the messy.txt content with leading/trailing whitespace and blank lines. Let me write the sanitize.sh script.

<tool_call>
<function=write>
<parameter=path>
sanitize.sh
</parameter>
<parameter=content>
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sanitize.sh: strip whitespace from each line, drop blank lines, write clean.txt
set -euo pipefail

INPUT="${1:-messy.txt}"
OUTPUT="${2:-clean.txt}"

: > "$OUTPUT"

while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # strip leading and trailing whitespace (spaces and tabs)
    stripped="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    stripped="${stripped%"${stripped##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    # skip blank lines
    [ -z "$stripped" ] && continue
    printf '%s\n' "$stripped" >> "$OUTPUT"
done < "$INPUT"

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
